title: Principal quotient dimension at a prime of full height
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let r be a nonzerodivisor of R, and let p be a prime ideal of R containing r. If the height of p equals the Krull dimension of R [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], then dim(R/(r)) + 1 = dim(R). Heights are regarded in WithBot ENat through the canonical coercion.

source.place: Tag 00KW, lemma-one-equation, and prime localization; the lower bound comes from the local quotient inequality, and the upper bound by extending prime chains below a regular element.

proof.text: The lower bound dim(R/(r)) + 1 <= dim R follows by lifting a prime chain from the quotient to R and adjoining below it a minimal prime, which does not contain the nonzerodivisor r. For the reverse inequality, the principal ideal height bound gives height(p) <= dim(R/(r)) + 1 since r belongs to p; substitute height(p) = dim R. Mathlib packages these two inequalities as Module.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors.
